title: Diffusion Models are Provably Efficient Priors for Sparse Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.24602v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have transformed generative modeling through their ability to capture and generate samples from complex data distributions. This success has spurred substantial interest in using pretrained diffusion models as expressive priors for highly ill-posed inverse problems in imaging and sensing. Despite strong empirical performance, theoretical understanding of this approach remains limited: existing guarantees are often asymptotic or entail prohibitive computational costs in the worst case. In this paper, we address this gap by studying sparse recovery from a small number of linear measurements, a classical problem in compressed sensing. We show that, given an accurate diffusion model capturing a sparsity-promoting Bernoulli-Gaussian prior, a likelihood-guided annealed Langevin sampler provably recovers the sparse signal in polynomial time with near-optimal sample complexity for a broad family of random and deterministic sen

translated_title: 扩散模型是稀疏恢复的可证明高效先验
translated_abstract: 扩散模型凭借其捕捉复杂数据分布并从中生成样本的能力，彻底改变了生成建模领域。这一成功激发了人们浓厚的兴趣，即将预训练的扩散模型用作成像与感知中高度病态逆问题的表达性先验。尽管经验性能出色，但这种方法的理论理解仍然有限：现有保证往往是渐近性的，或在最坏情况下需要难以承受的计算成本。在本文中，我们通过研究从少量线性测量中进行稀疏恢复这一压缩感知中的经典问题来填补这一空白。我们证明，给定一个准确刻画促进稀疏性的伯努利-高斯先验的扩散模型，一个由似然引导的退火朗之万采样器能够在多项式时间内、以近乎最优的样本复杂度，可证明地恢复稀疏信号，且适用于广泛的随机和确定性传感矩阵族。
tldr: 本文针对压缩感知中的稀疏恢复问题，首次证明基于预训练扩散模型先验的似然引导退火朗之万采样器能够在多项式时间内以近乎最优的样本复杂度可证明地恢复稀疏信号，为扩散模型作为逆问题先验提供了高效的端到端理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first provable end-to-end guarantee that a likelihood-guided annealed Langevin sampler with a pretrained diffusion prior recovers sparse signals in polynomial time with near-optimal sample complexity, establishing diffusion models as provably efficient priors for sparse recovery in compressed sensing.
